page.overview:
Who is Maxwell Headroom?

Maxwell Headroom was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century. He was a flag officer with the rank of vice admiral in 2364.

Between stardates 41417 and 41607, he was an officer at the Starfleet Mission Operations Division.

After 41607, he was an officer at the Starfleet Planetary Geosciences Division.
